result.verdict: UNDEFINED (DEPTH-3 INSTRUMENT ABSENT): the depth-matched RATE ceiling COLLAPSES at N=3 (mean held-out oracle 0.333 < 0.80, ~chance) while a strictly-shallower net CEILINGS (max oracle 1.000). The deep rate net is the BEST-POSSIBLE credit (full backprop) yet its N=3 arm does not generalize -- so the SNN's N=3 arm is confounded by the deep net's own GENERALIZATION collapse, NOT the credit rule. The compositional task is depth-<3-SOLVABLE, so the extra depth is surplus capacity that overfits (the 3rd-layer ceiling fits TRAIN but collapses on held-out inheritance) -- there is no depth-3-OBLIGATORY signal for the deepest layer to latch onto. Depth-3 credit is UNTESTABLE on this task. Meanwhile the shallower spatial depth IS load-bearing at small T (best interpretable N=2: snn 0.741 vs floor 0.593, +0.148) -- the temporal floor is defeated for depth-2. Next mechanism: build a depth-3-OBLIGATORY task (held-out generalization REQUIRES 3 composition levels: a depth-<3 rate net must UNDERFIT held-out, a depth-3 net must CLEAR it), verify that ceiling, THEN re-pose the transport-free DFA depth-3 credit sweep at small T on it. (NB the permuted anti-cheat also trips at 1 seed: small ~27-item held set, 0.037 resolution -> pooled out by the 6-seed sweep, not read as leakage.)

preconditions.name: temporal_window_small
preconditions.note: T=3 <= 4 -> the LIF temporal integration cannot substitute for spatial depth

preconditions.name: task_fittable_ceiling_exists
preconditions.note: max-over-N rate DendriticMLP oracle >= 0.80 -> a learnable ceiling EXISTS (task interpretable)

preconditions.name: depth_Nhi_ceiling_trainable
preconditions.note: depth-matched rate oracle at N=3 >= 0.80 -> the deepest arm is interpretable as a CREDIT result (else it is confounded by the deep net's own trainability)

preconditions.name: no_label_leakage
preconditions.note: permuted-label <= chance+0.05 at every (N,seed) (one-sided; leakage would be ABOVE chance)

preconditions.name: task_depth_separating
preconditions.note: stage0 depth-genuineness holds at every (N,seed): shallow oracle underfits, deep oracle fits

preconditions.name: n1_equals_1hidden_floor
preconditions.note: snn(N=1) == the 1-hidden floor (identical arch+seed) -> substrate is deterministic; else void

preconditions.name: depth_lever_moved
preconditions.note: the N sweep actually changed the spatial hidden depth (control N=1 vs treatment N=3)
